basis: Accepted REASSESSMENT_ZH.md, sections5-7; exact stage-g backbone and input bytes retained
data: EUA_LONG/GUANGZHOU/HUBEI/SHANGHAI archived development CSVs through2023; two exposed evaluation years2022/2023; no new official Tianjin/CEA scoring
information: 64 past price changes and current known volume context. No full-evaluation decomposition or evaluation-label tuning. Training residuals are in-sample for the training-only frozen backbone, not out-of-fold residuals.
folds: For each test-year start B and year-end E, A=B-126. Older validation[A-126,A), latest[A,B). Origins start64; all H20 labels must mature strictly before next boundary. Use all eight cells, same original-g test origins.
backbone: Each fold independently selects alpha[.001,.1,10] and LR[.003,.01] using its own validation; cap320/min15/patience12, exact ridge. Final refit uses latest fold choice and its epoch on all H20-mature labels before B. This latest backbone matches stage-g static, subject to numerical verification.
mechanism: U=R-RQQ^T, Q spans two fitted exponential lag weights and the last-coordinate vector. Primary delta=G(U,c)-G(0,c). c=[current signed change,two states,log short/long RMS ratio,volume surprise,volume mask]. Projection and c together retain raw-history information; this is an inductive-bias test, not new information or error independence.
tcn: Two Conv1D GELU layers kernel3/dilation1,2, same padding inside known window; four-bin average pooling and last token, context fusion MLP, three zero-initialized bias-free outputs. No dropout/BatchNorm; exact zero-reference cancellation.
neural_tuning: 8 Optuna TPE trials per cell/family, startup4, sampler seed20261020. Width16/32; LR log[.0003,.003]; weight decay log[.0001,.1]. Each trial fits seed17 on both rolling folds, mean best validation loss selects config. Same opportunities; TPE sequences after startup may differ by family. No trial pruning or test-based choices.
training: AdamW, batch128, gradient clip5, max80/min15/patience12, improve threshold1e-7. Final epochs equal latest-fold chosen epoch; independent refits seeds17,29,43,71,101. Mean seed loss primary; ensemble separately labeled. Epoch0 allowed and counted.
matched_control: raw_zero_at_primary_config uses exactly primary width/lr/decay/epoch/seeds, changes only projection, no extra selection. It is not an independently tuned baseline.
normalization: Each fold own price-change RMS and target second moments from fitting prefix; context RMS only fitting rows, no centering. Final uses latest-fold fixed scales, context RMS recomputed from final fit rows.
baselines: Ridge20lags alpha_mean [.0001,.001,.01,.1,1,10,100], sumalpha=alpha_mean*n; HGB leaf7/15 x L2 .1/1,100iters LR .05 no internal earlystop. Both select mean two-fold loss. HGB targets fit separately. BareTCN receives same features/tuning but has no base forecast.
outcome: Q per-cell equal H1/H5/H20 MSE/RW-MSE, then eight-cell equal mean; horizons are observed records. Report native RMSE/MAE/MAPE/price R2, per-market/year/horizon, all seeds and computational costs.
statistics: 20000 paired circular block bootstrap replications, block20 primary and40 sensitivity, seed20261020. Within each cell common indices for all models/horizons; recompute RW denominators each draw. Equal aggregate across8cells. Report marginal95 and eight-comparison individual99.375 intervals, invalid draws stop. Exploratory only: does not account for prior project searches or all cross-cell dependence.
interpretation: No universal percentage publication threshold, no demand all tests significant. Preserve negative results and old studies. No success paper unless claimed mechanism has meaningful attributable evidence. EWT and teacher supervision deferred until core representation test; neither is reported as executed.
novelty: Existing residual models, semi-structured orthogonalization and VLBM2026 are explicit prior art. No claim of first orthogonal-residual forecasting or guaranteed error reduction.
publication: Code, configuration and aggregate evidence on new draft GitHub branch; large safe trial histories and own numeric states as separate Library artifact if required. No third-party raw rows, per-origin arrays or binary weights publicly uploaded.
